policy: Separate post-launch DLC costume states from ordinary base-character physical figures. Preserve exact named droid identities even when generic body-family matches exist. Normalize British/American spelling variants before thresholding, but keep exact digital-to-physical artwork equivalence visual-pending unless directly verified.

systemic_findings: Post-launch novelty costumes must remain separate from ordinary physical variants of the same character.
R-series and other droid body families are not identity evidence without full model/name agreement.
Game-original characters need an explicit game-only route rather than nearest-neighbor physical matching.
Functional droid model names should use model-plus-role matching.
British/American spelling aliases such as Armourer/Armorer should normalize before thresholding.
